name: table-craft-workspace
description: Workspace root for the table-craft desktop app, its core and its datasource plugins

scripts.test:smoke: bun run --filter '@table-craft/desktop' build && TABLE_CRAFT_SMOKE=1 vitest run test/e2e
scripts.test:db: docker compose -f test/db/compose.yml up -d --wait && vitest run --config vitest.db.config.ts
scripts.desktop: bun run --filter '@table-craft/desktop' build && bun run --cwd packages/desktop start
scripts.desktop:package: bun run --filter '@table-craft/desktop' build && bun run --cwd packages/desktop package
